_what: When and how a tip names the shortcut for a command someone ran the slow way (shortcut-coaching.ts). `slower_paths` are the ways of running a command that a shortcut beats (the palette, a menu, a button); a command run by its keys is never coached. A tip is shown at most `max_per_command` times for one command, at least `min_gap_seconds` after the last tip, and at most `max_per_day` times a day; the person can turn tips off. `words.tip` fills {title} and {keys}.
